title: harness save mode returns success without checking preview-capture failures
detail: A broken preview directive appends to `fails` (lines 275, 281) and `continue`s, skipping the capture; but the save branch returns true before the fails check, silently blessing a demo missing a golden. The comment claims preview failures 'fail the demo LOUDLY', which only holds in run mode.
recommended_fix: In save mode, check `fails` before writing the manifest (or return false when any preview capture failed), matching run mode's loud-failure contract.

title: unknown at-verb diagnostic omits the new preview verb
evidence: return {}, fmt.tprintf("unknown at-verb %q (want draw|spawn|demolish|place|emphasis|lane): %s", fields[2], line)
detail: The parser error enumerates every accepted at-verb but the newly added `preview` case (line 347) is missing from the want-list, so a typo'd preview directive gets a misleading hint.

title: Upgrade-preview recompute runs two full Dijkstra rebuilds inside the render pass
evidence:
rl.BeginDrawing()
...
draw_hud(&app)
...
update_preview(app)
...
sh, err := pp.forecast_shift(&app.state.topology, &app.cat, pipe, to)
detail: draw_hud (line 162, inside BeginDrawing/EndDrawing) calls update_preview (643), which invokes pp.forecast_shift (587) — two full routing_rebuild_with_tiers passes plus allocation and App-state mutation — in the draw path. Memoized per (gen, pipe, tier), but sim-scale compute in the render pass could hitch a frame as maps grow.
recommended_fix: Trigger the recompute at the observable edit moments (handle_input's topology_apply_edit / step loop) and keep draw_hud render-only, or note the scale budget explicitly.
